articles.summary: Intrepid Potash, Inc. (“Intrepid” or “the Company”) (NYSE:IPI), a leading diversified mineral company serving the agriculture and animal feed markets, and the only U.S. producer of muriate of potash, today announced that the U.S. Department of Agriculture (“USDA”) selected Intrepid’s sulfate of potash (SOP) project for approximately $139 million in proposed matching funding to support the construction of a SOP manufacturing facility near Carlsbad, New Mexico, through its Fertilizer Investment Expansion for Long-Term Domestic Supply (“FIELDS”) program. If constructed, the SOP plant would introduce a new product to Intrepid’s portfolio, further diversifying the Company’s product offerings and expanding its presence in specialty fertilizer markets by complementing its Trio ® and potash fertilizer products. articles.summary: Intrepid Potash, Inc. (NYSE: IPI) plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, after the market closes. Intrepid will host a conference call on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss the results, outlook, and other operating and financial matters and answer investor questions. Management invites you to listen to the conference call by using the toll-free dial-in number 1 (833) 461-5787 or International dial-in number 1 (585) 542-9983; please use meeting ID 747926385. The call will also be streamed live via webcast . A recording of the conference call will be available approximately two hours after the completion of the call via webcast . The recording will be available for 12 months following the call.
